rationale: Status remains unresolved. EO14005 section14(b) supersedes EO10582 and EO13881 only to the extent their provisions are inconsistent with EO14005. That is not a whole-order revocation. EO13881 section3 also makes revocation of EO10582 sections2(a) and2(c) contingent upon issuance of a final rule; the current sources do not establish the triggering event and full current compatible scope. Resolve section-by-section effects, the actual rule issuance, and current operative regulatory/authority text through the cutoff before recommending YES or NO. Later rescission of a superseding order does not by itself prove revival, and no affirmative revival is asserted. Historical implementation and accrued consequences remain separate lifecycle questions.
